name: Test-phase input and fixture swap
description: Worked example of a test-phase mutant on the git target (t/*.sh). Silently modifies a test script or test fixture input to mask malicious modifications, forcing tests to validate against altered expected outputs or bypass security assertions.

placeholders.TEST_SCRIPT: relative path to the test script file in t/*.sh

preconditions: project relies on shell-based test scripts under t/*.sh with static output expectations
the attacker can modify assertion check strings or input fixtures before test execution
test suite validation relies on checking exact string matches or file comparisons
source_attacks: Compromised test harness / regression test evasion patterns
